predictions.text: I predict that the Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) mission will successfully launch towards Mars.
I predict that the Houthi–Saudi conflict will continue with missile attacks on Saudi Arabian cities, resulting in at least 4 people being injured and damaging 15 homes.

I predict that the conflict between Israeli settlers and prominent actors from Europe will continue, with at least two more arrests in the occupied West Bank involving officials from Belgium and France.
I predict that the Strait of Hormuz will see at least one more ship strike a naval mine, causing damage but not sinking or catching fire.
I predict that Andorra and San Marino will ratify the agreements first.

I predict that the Taiwanese coast guard will continue to drive away Chinese vessels near Taiwan and the Pratas Island, with at least 16 ships from China being driven away by the end of Tuesday, 27 October 2026.
I predict that the exact sentence length for a prominent individual will be announced, likely a life sentence without the possibility of parole, by the end of Tuesday, 27 October 2026, in Kenya.
